version_note: `claude --version` was re-probed at capture time and reported 2.1.251 (Claude Code) — the version this ticket targets. No discrepancy to record.
trust_note: The recording cwd was `git init`-ed and trust was granted in an EARLIER, discarded session, so the folder-trust dialog does not appear anywhere in this recording. bytes.raw starts at the alt-screen enter (ESC[?1049h) of a clean composer.
teardown_note: bytes.raw is TRUNCATED at the last byte of the settled dialog frame, deliberately, before the Ctrl-] detach teardown. SIGTERM makes claude leave the alt screen (ESC[?1049l) and print 'Resume this session with: claude --resume <id>', and a stream ending there replays as the resume text instead of the dialog. Same trap documented in permission-mode-bypass/meta.json.
expected_note: expected.txt was PRODUCED BY REPLAYING bytes.raw through src/screen's Screen at 120x40 and serializing as screenbench-record does (finalText.replace(/\s+$/u, '') + '\n'). It is not hand-typed.
